titleFront: I Can Bring You In Warm
titleBack: ...Or I Can Bring You In Cold

flipToBack.timing: Required trigger on battle initiation; resolution is an OPPONENT CHOICE, so the flip is not guaranteed
flipToBack.prose: When a battle is just initiated involving both Din and 'The Asset', a required singleton action makes the OPPONENT choose: (0) lose The Asset from table to exclude Din from the battle (and objective owner takes any one card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), or (1) flip this objective. Flip happens only if opponent picks option 1.

children.req: chosen-state: opponent selects 'Flip' over 'Lose The Asset to exclude Din (owner uploads any card)'
children.gameConditions: PlayoutDecisionEffect(action, opponent, ...) index==1 -> FlipCardEffect; index==0 -> LoseCardFromTableEffect(theAsset) + ExcludeFromBattleEffect(din) + TakeCardIntoHandFromReserveDeckEffect(self.getOwner(), true)

flipToFront.timing: Required trigger at the START of ANY move phase (either player's) - the back is inherently transient
flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front automatically at the start of any move phase. On flipping TO the back, an optional trigger lets the owner immediately re-circulate and shuffle their Reserve Deck.

children.req: timing-trigger: start of each MOVE phase

requirementSemantics: Flip-to-back is a battle-initiation TIMING trigger with two participant leaves (Din AND The Asset both participating) resolved by an OPPONENT CHOICE - unique among objectives in this batch: Rando cannot force the flip, only present the dilemma; opponent flipping is the 'good for them' branch since option 0 costs them The Asset and hands the owner a free upload of ANY card.
Flip-to-front is a pure phase-boundary timing trigger (start of any move phase), no board condition at all: the back lasts at most from a battle until the next move phase starts.

BACK while-up: if The Asset is just lost or forfeited, that character is placed out of play from Lost Pile (Card501_014_BACK.java:95-108); The Asset's game text is canceled (86); dark player may not cancel your non-lightsaber weapon destiny draws while The Asset is in battle (85, via InBattleCondition on the found-first-active The Asset).
FRONT while-up: The Asset may not move away from same location as Din (MayNotMoveAwayFromLocationModifier, Card501_014.java:101).
Housekeeping both sides: when The Asset leaves table, Holopuck's while-in-play data is cleared (front 168-176; back 93-115).
This is a SET 501 PLAYTESTING card (ExpansionSet.PLAYTESTING, setTestingText); absent from card_cache.json as expected.
typedIdentities: Filters.Din (persona; flip trigger participant; anchor for The Asset's movement lock)
Filters.The_Asset (flip trigger participant; back-side out-of-play target and game-text-cancel target)
Filters.Holopuck (setup deploy to Bounty Hunter's Guild; while-in-play-data cleared when The Asset leaves table)
Filters.Mudhorn_Location (once-per-turn download class, front; filter name as written in source)

Deploy ban (both sides, coded as while-active modifier each side): Filters.or(Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.Jedi, Filters.except(Filters.or(Filters.Luke, Filters.Ahsoka))), Filters.and(Filters.or(Icon.EPISODE_I, Icon.EPISODE_VII), Filters.character))

setupAndPullRoutes: Start of game (required, from Reserve Deck): Bounty Hunter's Guild (Card501_014.java:64), Holopuck deployed to Bounty Hunter's Guild via DeployCardToTargetFromReserveDeckEffect (71), Cold Storage (78), Bounty Hunting Is A Dangerous Profession (85).
FRONT: once per turn, deploy a [Mudhorn] location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle (Card501_014.java:106-124, GameTextActionId.I_CAN_BRING_YOU_IN_WARM__DOWNLOAD_MUDHORN_LOCATION).

FLIP-DILEMMA REWARD: if opponent chooses to lose The Asset, owner takes ANY one card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle (TakeCardIntoHandFromReserveDeckEffect(action, self.getOwner(), true), Card501_014.java:153-155).
ON FLIP TO BACK (optional): re-circulate and shuffle your Reserve Deck (Card501_014_BACK.java:56-76, TriggerConditions.cardFlipped).
otherObligations: BOTH SIDES: may not deploy your Jedi (except Luke and Ahsoka) or [Episode I]/[Episode VII] characters (front Card501_014.java:96-102; back Card501_014_BACK.java:79-88).
FRONT: 'The Asset' may not move away from same location as Din (Card501_014.java:101) - keeps the flip dilemma re-armable every battle at Din's location.

BACK: during battles involving The Asset, opponent may not cancel your non-lightsaber weapon destiny draws (Card501_014_BACK.java:85); The Asset's game text is canceled (86); if The Asset just lost/forfeited, place that character out of play (98-108).

Rando obligations: front - initiate battles with Din against The Asset to force the opponent dilemma repeatedly; each 'lose The Asset' resolution nets a free any-card upload; back - it auto-expires at the next move phase start, so exploit the weapon-destiny protection and Asset text-cancel in the battle window immediately after flipping.
